en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

zhSimplified.text: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所赐给你们居住的地，

zhTraditional.text: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所賜給你們居住的地，

en.text: and will make an offering by fire to the LORD—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock—

zhSimplified.text: 若愿意从牛群羊群中取牛羊作火祭，献给耶和华，无论是燔祭是平安祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作甘心祭，或是逢你们节期献的，都要奉给耶和华为馨香之祭。

zhTraditional.text: 若願意從牛群羊群中取牛羊作火祭，獻給耶和華，無論是燔祭是平安祭，為要還特許的願，或是作甘心祭，或是逢你們節期獻的，都要奉給耶和華為馨香之祭。

en.text: then he who offers his offering shall offer to the LORD a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.

footnotes.text: 15:4 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel
15:4 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons.

zhSimplified.text: 那献供物的就要将细面伊法十分之一，并油一欣四分之一，调和作素祭，献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 那獻供物的就要將細麵伊法十分之一，並油一欣四分之一，調和作素祭，獻給耶和華。

en.text: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

zhSimplified.text: 无论是燔祭是平安祭，你要为每只绵羊羔，一同预备奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。

zhTraditional.text: 無論是燔祭是平安祭，你要為每隻綿羊羔，一同預備奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。

en.text: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;

footnotes.text: 15:6 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

zhSimplified.text: 为公绵羊预备细面伊法十分之二，并油一欣三分之一，调和作素祭，

zhTraditional.text: 為公綿羊預備細麵伊法十分之二，並油一欣三分之一，調和作素祭，

en.text: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 又用酒一欣三分之一作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香之祭。

zhTraditional.text: 又用酒一欣三分之一作奠祭，獻給耶和華為馨香之祭。

en.text: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to the LORD,

zhSimplified.text: 你预备公牛作燔祭，或是作平安祭，为要还特许的愿，或是作平安祭，献给耶和华，

zhTraditional.text: 你預備公牛作燔祭，或是作平安祭，為要還特許的願，或是作平安祭，獻給耶和華，

en.text: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;

footnotes.text: 15:9 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

zhSimplified.text: 就要把细面伊法十分之三，并油半欣，调和作素祭，和公牛一同献上，

zhTraditional.text: 就要把細麵伊法十分之三，並油半欣，調和作素祭，和公牛一同獻上，

en.text: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 又用酒半欣作奠祭，献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。

zhTraditional.text: 又用酒半欣作奠祭，獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。

en.text: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

zhSimplified.text: 「献公牛、公绵羊、绵羊羔、山羊羔，每只都要这样办理。

zhTraditional.text: 「獻公牛、公綿羊、綿羊羔、山羊羔，每隻都要這樣辦理。

en.text: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

zhSimplified.text: 照你们所预备的数目，按着只数都要这样办理。

zhTraditional.text: 照你們所預備的數目，按着隻數都要這樣辦理。

en.text: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 凡本地人将馨香的火祭献给耶和华，都要这样办理。

zhTraditional.text: 凡本地人將馨香的火祭獻給耶和華，都要這樣辦理。

en.text: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD, as you do, so he shall do.

zhSimplified.text: 若有外人和你们同居，或有人世世代代住在你们中间，愿意将馨香的火祭献给耶和华，你们怎样办理，他也要照样办理。

zhTraditional.text: 若有外人和你們同居，或有人世世代代住在你們中間，願意將馨香的火祭獻給耶和華，你們怎樣辦理，他也要照樣辦理。

en.text: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 至于会众，你们和同居的外人都归一例，作为你们世世代代永远的定例，在耶和华面前，你们怎样，寄居的也要怎样。

zhTraditional.text: 至於會眾，你們和同居的外人都歸一例，作為你們世世代代永遠的定例，在耶和華面前，你們怎樣，寄居的也要怎樣。

en.text: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

zhSimplified.text: 你们并与你们同居的外人当有一样的条例，一样的典章。」

zhTraditional.text: 你們並與你們同居的外人當有一樣的條例，一樣的典章。」

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

zhSimplified.text: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们到了我所领你们进去的那地，

zhTraditional.text: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們到了我所領你們進去的那地，

en.text: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 吃那地的粮食，就要把举祭献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 吃那地的糧食，就要把舉祭獻給耶和華。

en.text: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要用初熟的麦子磨面，做饼当举祭奉献；你们举上，好像举禾场的举祭一样。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要用初熟的麥子磨麵，做餅當舉祭奉獻；你們舉上，好像舉禾場的舉祭一樣。

en.text: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations.

zhSimplified.text: 你们世世代代要用初熟的麦子磨面，当举祭献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 你們世世代代要用初熟的麥子磨麵，當舉祭獻給耶和華。

en.text: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses—

zhSimplified.text: 「你们有错误的时候，不守耶和华所晓谕摩西的这一切命令，

zhTraditional.text: 「你們有錯誤的時候，不守耶和華所曉諭摩西的這一切命令，

en.text: even all that the LORD has commanded you by Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—

zhSimplified.text: 就是耶和华借摩西一切所吩咐你们的，自那日以至你们的世世代代，

zhTraditional.text: 就是耶和華藉摩西一切所吩咐你們的，自那日以至你們的世世代代，

en.text: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

zhSimplified.text: 若有误行，是会众所不知道的，后来全会众就要将一只公牛犊作燔祭，并照典章把素祭和奠祭一同献给耶和华为馨香之祭，又献一只公山羊作赎罪祭。

zhTraditional.text: 若有誤行，是會眾所不知道的，後來全會眾就要將一隻公牛犢作燔祭，並照典章把素祭和奠祭一同獻給耶和華為馨香之祭，又獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭。

en.text: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their error.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要为以色列全会众赎罪，他们就必蒙赦免，因为这是错误。他们又因自己的错误，把供物，就是向耶和华献的火祭和赎罪祭，一并奉到耶和华面前。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要為以色列全會眾贖罪，他們就必蒙赦免，因為這是錯誤。他們又因自己的錯誤，把供物，就是向耶和華獻的火祭和贖罪祭，一並奉到耶和華面前。

en.text: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列全会众和寄居在他们中间的外人就必蒙赦免，因为这罪是百姓误犯的。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列全會眾和寄居在他們中間的外人就必蒙赦免，因為這罪是百姓誤犯的。

en.text: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

zhSimplified.text: 「若有一个人误犯了罪，他就要献一岁的母山羊作赎罪祭。

zhTraditional.text: 「若有一個人誤犯了罪，他就要獻一歲的母山羊作贖罪祭。

en.text: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before the LORD. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

zhSimplified.text: 那误行的人犯罪的时候，祭司要在耶和华面前为他赎罪，他就必蒙赦免。

zhTraditional.text: 那誤行的人犯罪的時候，祭司要在耶和華面前為他贖罪，他就必蒙赦免。

en.text: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列中的本地人和寄居在他们中间的外人，若误行了什么事，必归一样的条例。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列中的本地人和寄居在他們中間的外人，若誤行了甚麼事，必歸一樣的條例。

en.text: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.

zhSimplified.text: 但那擅敢行事的，无论是本地人是寄居的，他亵渎了耶和华，必从民中剪除。

zhTraditional.text: 但那擅敢行事的，無論是本地人是寄居的，他褻瀆了耶和華，必從民中剪除。

en.text: Because he has despised the LORD’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”

zhSimplified.text: 因他藐视耶和华的言语，违背耶和华的命令，那人总要剪除；他的罪孽要归到他身上。」

zhTraditional.text: 因他藐視耶和華的言語，違背耶和華的命令，那人總要剪除；他的罪孽要歸到他身上。」

en.text: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人在旷野的时候，遇见一个人在安息日捡柴。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人在曠野的時候，遇見一個人在安息日撿柴。

en.text: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

zhSimplified.text: 遇见他捡柴的人，就把他带到摩西、亚伦并全会众那里，

zhTraditional.text: 遇見他撿柴的人，就把他帶到摩西、亞倫並全會眾那裏，

en.text: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

zhSimplified.text: 将他收在监内；因为当怎样办他，还没有指明。

zhTraditional.text: 將他收在監內；因為當怎樣辦他，還沒有指明。

en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华吩咐摩西说：「总要把那人治死；全会众要在营外用石头把他打死。」

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華吩咐摩西說：「總要把那人治死；全會眾要在營外用石頭把他打死。」

en.text: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as the LORD commanded Moses.

zhSimplified.text: 于是全会众将他带到营外，用石头打死他，是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。

zhTraditional.text: 於是全會眾將他帶到營外，用石頭打死他，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.

zhSimplified.text: 「你吩咐以色列人，叫他们世世代代在衣服边上做 子，又在底边的 子上钉一根蓝细带子。

zhTraditional.text: 「你吩咐以色列人，叫他們世世代代在衣服邊上做繸子，又在底邊的繸子上釘一根藍細帶子。

en.text: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all the LORD’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;

zhSimplified.text: 你们佩带这 子，好叫你们看见就记念遵行耶和华一切的命令，不随从自己的心意、眼目行邪淫，像你们素常一样；

zhTraditional.text: 你們佩帶這繸子，好叫你們看見就記念遵行耶和華一切的命令，不隨從自己的心意、眼目行邪淫，像你們素常一樣；

en.text: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

zhSimplified.text: 使你们记念遵行我一切的命令，成为圣洁，归与你们的 神。

zhTraditional.text: 使你們記念遵行我一切的命令，成為聖潔，歸與你們的上帝。

en.text: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.”

zhSimplified.text: 「我是耶和华—你们的 神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来，要作你们的 神。我是耶和华—你们的 神。」

zhTraditional.text: 「我是耶和華－你們的上帝，曾把你們從埃及地領出來，要作你們的上帝。我是耶和華－你們的上帝。」
